newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RANDGOLD SAYS HAS KNIGHTS, RMP AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: RANDGOLD SAYS HAS KNIGHTS, RMP AGREEMENT.

text.p: South African mining house Randgold & Exploration Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it had agreed a deal in principle with RMP Properties Ltd and Knights Gold Mining.
"Agreement in principle has been reached amongst the parties and...full details of these agreements will be made available shortly," the firm said in a statement.
The firms have been in talks on the formation of a new company, Newco, which would be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
The talks involved the acquisition by Newco of Knight's assets and RMP Properties Ltd's land clearing and gold recovery operations.
Shareholders were urged to continue to exercise caution in their sharedealings until further details are announced.
